name: F02 · 29 ЦРНИ МЕРМЕРНИ GLB · изложбена библиотека
description: All 29 genuine owner-render-reference black marble models: full, two halves, four quarters, four tiny exposed borders, four 60mm corner caps, four actual L-shaped showcase corners, four raised long showcase borders, F02-F pool curve, three F02-G raised curves, H/I finishes. Every model individually movable. Not installed in game.
